name: Portable AC units
tagline: Plug-in cooling you can move room to room
description: Wheeled, self-contained units for rented spaces, temporary needs and spot cooling where a fixed AC isn't possible.
long_description: A portable AC rolls on castors and vents hot air outside through a flexible hose fitted to a window kit. It needs no mounting or refrigerant piping, so it's ready to use within minutes. It's best for spot cooling, short-term needs or spaces where drilling walls isn't allowed.
use_case: Rented spaces, events and spot cooling
features: No installation: plug in and vent the hose outside
Castor wheels to move between rooms
Ideal where wall drilling isn't permitted

variants.suits: Rooms up to about 120 sq ft

considerations: Less efficient than a split or window AC of the same capacity
Needs a window or opening for the exhaust hose
Best for short-term or spot cooling rather than all-day use

faqs.question: Does a portable AC need installation?
faqs.answer: No. Just fit the exhaust hose to the window kit and plug it in. We can supply and set it up for you.

faqs.question: Do you rent portable ACs?
faqs.answer: Ask us about short-term needs for events or breakdowns and we'll suggest the best option.
